en: A black and white photograph showing a waterfront scene with several small sailboats and a prominent pier extending into the water. On the left side of the image, there is a striking building with a tall clock tower and ornate architectural details. People can be seen walking along the pier. The background consists of additional historic buildings and a steeple, suggesting an old European town.
